title: Yellow Split Pea Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew from the Middle East, made with yellow split peas, nutty flavor and a hint of chewiness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the middle eastern spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yellow split peas, diced tomatoes, and pea broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of nutty or chewy if desired.
